note: Values are Starbucks' official U.S. nutrition figures from starbucks.com, checked on October 25, 2026. Drinks are the standard recipe (for most lattes that means 2% milk and the default number of syrup pumps and toppings); changing the milk, syrup or toppings changes the numbers, and Starbucks does not publish separate values for each change. Confirm current figures with Starbucks, especially for allergies or medical diets.

meta.values_origin: Every value was copied on 2026-10-25 from the nutrition panel of each product on starbucks.com (U.S. menu), for Tall, Grande and Venti (other sizes where a drink has no Tall/Grande/Venti). 536 items. Each item links to its own official product page.
meta.serving_basis: One drink of the size named, standard recipe as Starbucks makes it (default milk, syrup pumps and toppings), or one food item.
meta.addon_macros: Starbucks shows nutrition for each finished drink and size, not for each milk, syrup pump or topping, so this calculator lists drinks by size and has no add-ons.

changelog.change: New calculator: 536 drinks and food items from the official U.S. Starbucks menu, with saturated fat, sugar and fiber.
